title: ペルソナ2 罪
sources: yomikata scan 0.1.0 of the disc files: shift_jis 609, utf16le 62 characters of prose-like text
Genkan memory search during play: the game uses its own table
Replay of a Genkan savestate (docs/replay.md): the 12x12 font in memory, the window's cells and the text pointer
The disc's packed scene files, unpacked: every message decoded to proofread the table; the control words counted
Persona 2: Batsu's script (same font up to 0x0A0E), decoded the same way: 48 more codes confirmed, one doubtful code taken out
notes: Own table: 16-bit glyph numbers into the game's 12x12 font. Words 0x11xx are controls without an argument, 0x12xx controls with one argument word (the layout's `codes`): 0x121D colour, 0x1205 pause, 0x1208 opens a choice of that many answers and 0x1109 waits for it, 0x120E a speaker's name by number, 0x1112 to 0x1114 the hero's names. Names put in by a code read as nothing; 0x111F to 0x1121 are gaps, in the table as a space. Partial: 33 codes the script uses are left out of the table (in doubt or blank, 125 uses on the whole disc) and read as U+FFFD; a choice's answers are part of its message.
